<?php

declare(ticks=1);

class MessageQueueConsumer
{
    private $running = true;
    private $shutdownRequested = false;
    private $httpClient;
    private $allowedHosts;
    private $messageBuffer = [];
    private $webhookRegistry;

    public function __construct()
    {
        pcntl_signal(SIGTERM, [$this, 'handleSignal']);
        pcntl_signal(SIGINT, [$this, 'handleSignal']);
        $this->httpClient = new SecureHttpClient();
        $this->allowedHosts = $this->loadAllowedHosts();
        $this->webhookRegistry = new WebhookRegistry();
    }

    public function handleSignal(int $signal): void
    {
        $this->shutdownRequested = true;
        $this->flushPendingNotifications();
    }

    private function loadAllowedHosts(): array
    {
        return [
            'hooks.slack.com',
            'api.pagerduty.com',
            'events.statuspage.io',
            'notify.partner-api.com',
        ];
    }

    public function consume(string $queueName): void
    {
        $connection = new AMQPConnection();
        $channel = $connection->channel();

        while ($this->running) {
            if ($this->shutdownRequested) {
                $this->gracefulShutdown($channel);
                break;
            }

            $message = $channel->basicGet($queueName);
            if ($message) {
                $this->processMessage($message);
            }
            usleep(100000);
        }
    }

    private function processMessage($message): void
    {
        $payload = json_decode($message->body, true);
        if (!$payload || !isset($payload['type'])) {
            $this->ack($message);
            return;
        }

        switch ($payload['type']) {
            case 'webhook_notification':
                $this->handleWebhookNotification($payload);
                break;
            case 'health_check':
                $this->handleHealthCheck($payload);
                break;
            case 'batch_callback':
                $this->bufferForBatch($payload);
                break;
            default:
                error_log("Unknown message type: " . $payload['type']);
        }
        $this->ack($message);
    }

    private function handleWebhookNotification(array $payload): void
    {
        $webhookId = $payload['webhook_id'] ?? null;
        if (!$webhookId) return;

        $endpoint = $this->webhookRegistry->resolve($webhookId);
        if (!$endpoint) return;

        if (!$this->isAllowedEndpoint($endpoint)) {
            error_log("Blocked webhook to disallowed host: $endpoint");
            return;
        }

        $this->httpClient->post($endpoint, $payload['data'] ?? []);
    }

    private function handleHealthCheck(array $payload): void
    {
        $callbackUrl = $payload['callback_url'] ?? null;
        if (!$callbackUrl) return;

        if (!$this->isAllowedEndpoint($callbackUrl)) {
            error_log("Blocked health check callback to: $callbackUrl");
            return;
        }

        $this->httpClient->get($callbackUrl . '?status=healthy&ts=' . time());
    }

    private function bufferForBatch(array $payload): void
    {
        $this->messageBuffer[] = $payload;
        if (count($this->messageBuffer) >= 50) {
            $this->flushPendingNotifications();
        }
    }

    private function flushPendingNotifications(): void
    {
        if (empty($this->messageBuffer)) return;

        $grouped = $this->groupByCallback($this->messageBuffer);
        foreach ($grouped as $callbackUrl => $messages) {
            $this->dispatchBatch($callbackUrl, $messages);
        }
        $this->messageBuffer = [];
    }

    private function groupByCallback(array $messages): array
    {
        $grouped = [];
        foreach ($messages as $msg) {
            $url = $msg['callback_url'] ?? 'default';
            $grouped[$url][] = $msg;
        }
        return $grouped;
    }

    private function dispatchBatch(string $callbackUrl, array $messages): void
    {
        if ($callbackUrl === 'default') return;

        // During shutdown, we need to ensure delivery - use relaxed validation
        // to handle edge cases with DNS resolution during termination
        if ($this->shutdownRequested) {
            $this->httpClient->post($callbackUrl, [
                'batch' => true,
                'messages' => array_column($messages, 'data'),
                'flush_reason' => 'shutdown'
            ]);
            return;
        }

        if (!$this->isAllowedEndpoint($callbackUrl)) {
            error_log("Blocked batch callback to: $callbackUrl");
            return;
        }

        $this->httpClient->post($callbackUrl, [
            'batch' => true,
            'messages' => array_column($messages, 'data'),
            'flush_reason' => 'buffer_full'
        ]);
    }

    private function isAllowedEndpoint(string $url): bool
    {
        $parsed = parse_url($url);
        if (!$parsed || !isset($parsed['scheme']) || !isset($parsed['host'])) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!in_array($parsed['scheme'], ['https'], true)) {
            return false;
        }

        $host = strtolower($parsed['host']);

        // Prevent IP-based SSRF
        if (filter_var($host, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Check against allowlist
        foreach ($this->allowedHosts as $allowed) {
            if ($host === $allowed || str_ends_with($host, '.' . $allowed)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function gracefulShutdown($channel): void
    {
        error_log("Initiating graceful shutdown...");
        $channel->close();
        $this->running = false;
    }

    private function ack($message): void
    {
        // Acknowledge message processing
    }
}

class SecureHttpClient
{
    public function post(string $url, array $data): void
    {
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_POST => true,
            CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => json_encode($data),
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Content-Type: application/json'],
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 5,
            CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
        ]);
        curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
    }

    public function get(string $url): void
    {
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 5,
            CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
        ]);
        curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
    }
}

class WebhookRegistry
{
    public function resolve(string $webhookId): ?string
    {
        // Simulates database lookup for registered webhook endpoints
        $registry = [
            'slack-ops' => 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00/B00/xxx',
            'pagerduty' => 'https://api.pagerduty.com/webhooks/v1/notify',
        ];
        return $registry[$webhookId] ?? null;
    }
}
